question: Do fixed counts explain f49v marginal repetitions and conditionally the adjacent numerals?
exposure: Exploratory test fixed after reading sources and image, before calculating results; not blind preregistration.
anchor_status: conditional numeral-to-sign correspondence, not authenticated plaintext; first numeral visually less certain
metrics: word tokens with each ZL comma independently joined or split
EVA code count with rare @number; counted once
mechanical bench units: c[ktpf]h, ch, sh each once, other EVA codes once

parsing.exclude: all marginal labels, paragraph markers and nontext annotations
parsing.drawing_gap: <-> converted to word separator; both sides of plant included in same physical row
parsing.alternatives: all inline readings expanded; per-row count sets deduplicated
parsing.unknown_margin: each ? unconstrained; not one shared value
parsing.bench_units: Do not form ligature across any recorded certain or uncertain space; no such potential cross-boundary ligature found in these rows.

spaces: All combinations of possible per-row word counts; no choice optimized and retained as correct reading. IT has no comma uncertainty.
direction: top to bottom; arbitrary signed offset for ordinary counts; invertible affine step for modular counts
unanchored_model: One fixed value per repeated known marginal sign; different signs may share a value. Equality of counts modulo m requires m to divide every same-sign difference, hence their gcd G. G=1 excludes every modulus m>1 for this count vector and any invertible affine reparameterization. G=0 does not constrain a period. This is a necessary condition, not decipherment.
anchored_model: Ordinary affine a*n+b, a nonzero rational, b rational; or (a*n+b) mod m for m=6..64, gcd(a,m)=1. Must satisfy all five adjacent numerals and all repeated-sign equality constraints. Literal case is checked for G=0. No refitting by row/paragraph; reset counts as separately specified.
success: Surviving rule is only a candidate. It must predict all repeated values without changing parameters, survive reading sensitivity, and receive independent historical/semantic validation before any decoding claim.
negative_scope: Only specified counting families and source readings. No inference of no message; no exclusion of arbitrary arithmetic, other glyph alphabets, unmarked segmentation errors, or a later annotation experiment.
controls: Known period7, deliberately contradictory repeated symbol, all-unknown and literal cases; these check arithmetic, not historical decoding.
